images.title: Five slots, thirty six choices each
images.purpose: Shows an alphanumeric code of length 5 as five slots with 36 choices each, giving 36⁵ = 60466176 codes.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of five tall rounded slots with a brace above and the total below.
images.exact_structure: One row of five equal tall rounded rectangles with teal (#0072B2) outlines and no text inside, evenly spaced. Above them an amber (#E69F00) brace labelled 36 choices each. Under the brace label the small label 26 letters + 10 digits. Below the slots the label 36⁵ = 60466176 in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Exactly 5 slots. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: With 36 choices in each of 5 slots there are 36⁵ codes.
images.description: Shows an alphanumeric code of length 5 as five slots with 36 choices each, giving 36⁵ = 60466176 codes.

image_decisions.why: The practice counts codes slot by slot, and this shows the slots and their choices in the simplest form.
